subject: Taxes
title: Trump's Tax Returns Battle
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: Trump's Tax Returns Battle.

hook.text: Donald Trump was the first president since Nixon not to release tax returns.

buildup.text: Congress subpoenaed Trump's returns using a law that says the IRS 'shall furnish' returns to Congress.

discovery.text: When finally released in 2022, the returns showed Trump paid $750 in federal tax in 2016 and 2017.

twist.text: The IRS had a mandatory audit program for presidential returns—but hadn't actually audited Trump during his term.

climax.text: The battle showed that presidential tax transparency relies on norms, not law.

punchline.text: $750 in tax. No audit. Norms aren't laws, and that matters.

quiz.question: What did Trump's released tax returns reveal?
options: He paid $750 in federal tax in 2016 and 2017, and zero in many prior years
